meta.title: Mistral Pro
meta.description: Connects a Mistral subscription to DSH: multi-account failover, live model catalog, sidebar usage card, statistics panel and a settings page.

section.title: Mistral Pro
section.subtitle: Mistral subscription accounts, models and usage

keys.title: Keys
keys.hint: Paste each key once. Vibe is tried first, Studio second; extra accounts and custom base URLs stay under Accounts.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Requests try accounts from top to bottom. A key that fails authentication, rate limiting or quota is skipped before any text is produced.
accounts.empty: No account yet. Add one to start using Mistral models.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.keyRefHint: Environment-variable name the key is stored under, e.g. MISTRAL_API_KEY.
accounts.baseURLHint: Leave empty to use the provider default (https://api.mistral.ai/v1).

models.title: Models
models.hint: Hidden models disappear from the model selector. Capacity overrides apply to the next request.
models.empty: No models discovered yet. Add an account, then refresh.

usage.title: Subscription usage
usage.hint: Mistral exposes subscription allowances on the admin site, which needs a browser session cookie. Paste a Cookie header from an admin.mistral.ai request to enable the sidebar usage card.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.cacheReportUsageHint: Turning this off also hides cached-token counts.
advanced.transportHint: https posts the serialized body over node:https (default, correct); fetch lets in-process wrappers see and rewrite the request.
